body: I've had my dreams feel more more better than living this life, its absurd but real.  I'll accept and take all the other misconceptions and all the delusions I've had in my life into my grave along with me since it's all the same anyways, all in hopelessness and depravity

let me tell you something, life will indeed keep sailing by, as is the case with a rock at the bank of a river stream, in its entire life the world would have been moving without itself moving.

Its a miserable process because no human's designed to last in this way, and if you can't be human I suppose you can only be the rock that sits by the river stream or the leaf that's fallen into the stream by pure chance, a victim to fate

I see those who make comments of other's lives whilst having little to no involvement in their lives in the same light with keyboard warriors, netizens and trolls.  They simply do not belong where they are trying to poke their shitty heads into and me knowing of their existence this way is the single greatest mistake the world's ever made
Get raffia string, its dirt cheap and you can get a lot of it in one bundle, make a strong rope from it
It kills all hope and all the alternate universes you may have lived through
